submission.justification: Module-D2 gives the highest light yield at 30% coverage (50.873 PE/MeV), but its thermal failure fraction is 0.30, far above the 0.05 robustness limit. Since modules cannot be accessed after the cryostat is filled, D2 is ruled out. Among the remaining designs that pass the robustness limit, Module-D3 at 30% coverage gives the highest light collection, 38.875 PE/MeV, with a thermal failure fraction of 0.02. Module-D1 reaches only 24.598 PE/MeV at 30% (thermal failure 0.005). The 30% coverage is at the upper bound of the allowed 5–30% range and is within the feedthrough support limit of 30%. The electronics are validated for all designs.
